{{Dialogue|Ben|A Master hanging back to watch her students fight an enemy so she'd learn about them.|Luke|Though she seemed perfectly content to sacrifice them.|Vestara|You're a big prize, Master Skywalker. Well worth the sacrifice of a few Sabers and apprentices.|attr=Ben Skywalker, Vestara Khai, and Luke Skywalker, following the duel|src=<ref name="Con" />}}
In [[44 ABY]], a '''duel''' occurred near the [[Kesla Vein pumping station|pumping station]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesla Vein]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], when three [[Sith Saber]]s of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by Saber [[Tola Annax]] attacked [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and outcast [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were dispatched to capture Khai and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Skywalkers; additionally, both sides were searching for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Destructors|entity]] [[Abeloth]]. These aims led to a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between the two factions. While Annnax watched, her three companions [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] the Jedi and Khai in three separate duels and were quickly killed. Annax escaped and the Jedi group soon came under another [[Second duel in Kesla Vein|attack]] from their enemies.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Have you found Abeloth yet? We have some justice in mind for her, too.|Tola Annax, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Con" />}}
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM|quote=with FotJ starting at 43.5.}}</ref> the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son&mdash;the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]&mdash;discovered that a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Destructors|entity]] called [[Abeloth]] was causing a [[Force psychosis]] that had befallen several Jedi Knights of the [[New Jedi Order]]. The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]&mdash;also encountered Abeloth in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]],<ref name="Aby">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> and [[High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] convinced the Skywalkers to ally themselves with the Sith to defeat Abeloth. However, their [[Mission to the Maw|attempt]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the entity was unsuccessful and the alliance was [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|broken]].<ref name="All">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Exiled Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker]]
The Skywalkers and the outcast [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]&mdash;who was forced to help the Jedi after [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|killing]] Taalon when the High Lord began to transform into another Abeloth-like [[The Ones/Legends|being]]&mdash;[[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] Abeloth and located her on the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]<ref name="Con" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" /> Luke Skywalker had established a [[blood trail]] on Abeloth and was therefore able to find the entity on the world. The Sith also tried to find Abeloth, and Khai sent a secret message to her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Gavar Khai]], revealing that Abeloth and the Jedi group were on Nam Chorios. The elder Khai dispatched several [[Sith Saber]]s to the planet in order to find and capture his daughter as well as kill the Skywalkers.<ref name="Con" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''You know me, traitor. And it's time for your companions to die, and for you to be taken to your father for questioning.''"<br />"''Tola Annax.|Vestara Khai and Tola Annax, shortly before the outbreak of the duel|<ref name="Con" />}}
Led by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]], a group consisting of Annax and three additional Sabers found the Skywalkers and Vestara Khai near the [[Kesla Vein pumping station|pumping station]] of the [[City/Legends|town]] [[Kesla Vein]]. When the Jedi group returned to their [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], Annax [[Force jump/Legends|jumped]] on their vehicle and demanded that Vestara surrender. She neglected to do so, and Annax reacted by sending the rest of her team to attack the Jedi and the Sith girl. While the Keshiri Saber stayed behind, the other three engaged all three enemies in one-against-one [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duels]]. Vestara [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fought]] against a [[Gavar Khai's petty officer|petty officer]] of her father's; he tried to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] stones at her, but she was able to strike her enemy down by [[Shiak|stabbing]] her blade through his [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker cut his [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Luke Skywalker victim)|enemy]] [[Sai cha/Legends|in two]] and rushed to help his son. However, the younger Skywalker [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] his [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Ben Skywalker victim)|opponent]] shortly afterward. Annax escaped after the defeat of her team, using a cable to climb a ravine before [[Pilot/Legends|driving]] away in another airspeeder. Additionally, the Keshiri destroyed the Jedi's speeder, leaving them without a vehicle.<ref name="Con" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|How about ''you'' surrender to ''our'' justice?''"<br />"''Some other time.|Vestara Khai and Tola Annax, shortly before the latter's escape|<ref name="Con" />}}
The Sith [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]] used the Force during the duel, an action that caused a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] somewhere on the planet, as the [[tsil]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on Nam Chorios greatly boosted and redirected Force energy. A short time after the duel, Luke Skywalker received a message from the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Kandra Nilitz]], who was able to convince the Grand [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] to meet with her. Shortly before arriving at Nilitz's [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], the Jedi group once again had to [[Second duel in Kesla Vein|fight off]] several Sith, but they escaped and continued the search for Abeloth in the city of [[Crystal Valley]]. The Sith, meanwhile, also continued their search for Abeloth and the Jedi, leading to another [[Operation Shieldfall|confrontation]] between the three parties.<ref name="Con" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish first appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. ''Conviction'' was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Con" />
